<table style="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt;border-spacing:0;width:100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
<tr style="page-break-inside:avoid">
<td style="width:11%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><span style="font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;8.01.</span></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"> <p style=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold;text-align:left">Other Events. </p></td></tr></table> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On March&#160;12, 2026, Northern States Power Company, a Minnesota corporation <span style="white-space:nowrap">(&#8220;NSP-Minnesota&#8221;),</span> issued $600&#160;million in aggregate principal amount of 4.85% First Mortgage Bonds, Series due May&#160;15, 2036 and $600&#160;million in aggregate principal amount of 5.55% First Mortgage Bonds, Series due May&#160;15, 2056 (collectively, the &#8220;bonds&#8221;) pursuant to an Underwriting Agreement among <span style="white-space:nowrap">NSP-Minnesota</span> and BNP Paribas Securities Corp., KeyBanc Capital Markets Inc., PNC Capital Markets LLC, SMBC Nikko Securities America, Inc. and U.S. Bancorp Investments, Inc., as representatives of the underwriters named therein. The bonds are being issued pursuant to the registration statement on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">S-3</span> (File <span style="white-space:nowrap"><span style="white-space:nowrap">No.&#160;333-278797-04)</span></span> (the &#8220;Registration Statement&#8221;). A prospectus supplement relating to the offering and sale of the bonds was filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on March&#160;6, 2026. The bonds will be governed by <span style="white-space:nowrap">NSP-Minnesota&#8217;s</span> Supplemental and Restated Trust Indenture dated May&#160;1, 1988, by and between <span style="white-space:nowrap">NSP-Minnesota</span> and The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A., as successor trustee, and the Supplemental Trust Indenture dated as of February&#160;1, 2026. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K</span> is being filed to report as exhibits certain documents in connection with that offering and sale for incorporation by reference into the Registration Statement. </p> <p style="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>
